confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on several aggregated but dated or crowdsourced sources, and the sources disagree (Jeonju meal estimates range about $5 to $10). Beer and coffee are inferred from Seoul-level data scaled down for a smaller city. Cocktail is a loose estimate from Seoul ranges. Wine glass has no direct source and is set from the beer-to-wine relationship, so it is low confidence. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city context, not checked against listings. The FX value was taken from search-result summaries of the RBA 4:00 pm rate and was not read directly from the RBA page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mid-sized Korean provincial city. Food and drink levels are scaled down from Seoul using the reported roughly 30% overall cost gap between Jeonju and Seoul. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a regional Korean city with a historic hanok district and tourist demand.
